content: {"episode_id":"ep-05004","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9) and cerebral infarction (Z86.73). Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management. We submit this documentation as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity invited by the payer letter and request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 751.68."}
